title: Good: Identity::Debug impl properly redacts seed and privkey
description:
Location: rust/lichen-link/src/identity.rs lines 56-66

The Identity struct holds Seed and PrivateKey (secret key material). The custom Debug impl properly outputs '[REDACTED]' for these fields instead of the raw bytes. This prevents accidental key leakage via debug logging or panic messages.

This is worth defending against 'simplification' suggestions to derive Debug - the manual impl is intentional and security-critical.
